The '''Ground Pounders''' or '''"Gee-Pees"''' were one of three roving [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleets that patrolled the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The other fleets were the [[Tapani Defense Force]] and [[Swift Wing]].

The Gee-Pees were a small, highly mobile fleet that were often given specialist assignments such as interception and seizure, and air-to-surface bombardment. The fleet spent most of its time on patrols through the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], but this duty was secondary to any special assignment. It was not uncommon for the Ground Pounders to break off a patrol to respond to an emergency within the sector.
